newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Central Bank sells 223.755 bln rbls bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russian Central Bank sells 223.755 bln rbls bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank sold 223.755 billion roubles nominal of OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Tuesday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 24011 issue closed on Tuesday at 100.82 percent, the 24012 issue closed at 99.90 percent and 24012 closed at 97.67 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the Central Bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
